children: Computer controlled explosives, colloquially referred to as Smart Mines, can be set up in a perimeter and programmed to monitor a specific area. When activated, they explode like any other Mine, but the criteria for their activation can be as general or as specific as is required. Smart Mines designate targets by using sensors that detect thermal emissions, heat, or ground vibration. They are also equipped with IFF systems, so they do not harm allied units.
When a Smart Mine is installed, the operator must designate the Mine's detonation criteria and succeed on a
check with a DC of 10. Success indicates that the Smart Mine behaves as programmed. Specific criteria include minimum range (typically within the Smart Mine's
radius), target size (such as detonating only when Medium or Large creatures pass within its
area), and the minimum number of targets (such as detonating only if two or more creatures are within the
